displayPackage.narrative: Embark on a memorable 7-night family adventure in Dubai and Istanbul! Begin your journey with 4 nights in Dubai, staying at the comfortable Metropolitan Hotel Dubai (4★). Enjoy exciting experiences like a Heritage Camel Safari and breathtaking views from At The Top Burj Khalifa Level 148, with all transfers included for a hassle-free experience. Then, head to Istanbul for 3 nights at the charming Armada Hotel Old City Sultanahmet (4★). Discover the city's rich history with a Bosphorus Sunset Cruise and a full-day tour of Byzantine and Ottoman treasures, including the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. Perfect for creating unforgettable family memories on your first trip abroad!

selected.name: Metropolitan Hotel Dubai
selected.address: Sheikh Zayed Road - Exit 41, Al Thanya Street
selected.description: This stylish property is situated in the city of Dubai, just an 8-minute walking distance from FGB metro station and a short driving distance from the international airport. The amazing Wild Wadi park, ideal for guests travelling with children, is about a 10-minute driving distance, and a choice of exclusive shopping malls are to be found in the surrounding area. The accommodation units feature a modern design and come complete with a large choice of premium amenities to ensure the finest living environment for guests. Gastronomy lovers will appreciate the onsite Italian restaurant whilst the English pub is the best place where to share nice moments with friends while having a glass of wine. Corporate meetings and cocktail parties can be held in the flexible meeting spaces available onsite.

alternatives.name: Ramada Hotel & Suites by Wyndham JBR
alternatives.address: Shams Cluster 3 The Walk,Jumeirah Beach Residence
alternatives.description: Ramada Hotel and Suites is located in one of the most vibrant and popular locations in Dubai - The Walk, Jumeirah Beach Residence. Surrounded by a variety of leisure, dining, shopping and entertainment options. It is a 5-minute walk to Jumeira Beach and highly accessible. It features spacious deluxe rooms, one and two-bedroom suites meticulously designed with bright accents. Its magnificent penthouse offers spectacular panoramic views of Dubai Marina and the Arabian Gulf. Family one-bedroom apartments are also available for big families with tastefully unique accommodation and great value.

alternatives.name: Millennium Airport Hotel Dubai
alternatives.description:
Millennium Airport Hotel Dubai is an award-winning contemporary lifestyle hotel that combines comfort, convenience, and exceptional hospitality in one of Dubai's most accessible locations. Just five minutes from Dubai International Airport (DXB) and within walking distance of Al Garhoud Metro Station, the hotel offers seamless access to the city's major business districts, shopping destinations, and iconic attractions, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travellers. 

Recognised for its outstanding service and commitment to excellence, the hotel has been named the Middle East's Leading Airport Hotel at the World Travel Awards 2025 for the thirteenth time since 2008. It also received the prestigious title of United Arab Emirates' Leading Airport Hotel 2025, reinforcing its reputation as one of the region's premier hospitality destinations. 

The hotel features 341 spacious, elegantly appointed, non-smoking guest rooms and suites, including Superior, Deluxe, Grand Rooms, and Executive Deluxe Suites. 

Guests can enjoy an exceptional culinary experience across nine distinctive restaurants and bars, serving a variety of international cuisines, including Italian, Mexican, Japanese, Indian, and international buffet selections. The hotel also offers vibrant nightlife venues, providing memorable dining and entertainment experiences. 

Leisure facilities include a large outdoor swimming pool with a pool bar, beautifully landscaped gardens, a children's playground, a spa, a beauty salon, and a fully equipped fitness centre. The hotel also offers versatile meeting and event venues for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations, including a ballroom, 7 meeting venues supported by dedicated event professionals. 

The Millennium Airport Hotel Dubai continues to be a preferred destination for travellers seeking comfort, convenience, and an outstanding stay in the heart of Dubai.

alternatives.description: Located in the centre of the Deira district, this luxurious hotel is 200 metres from the Al Rigga metro station and a 10-minute drive from Dubai International Airport. All rooms are spacious and elegantly furnished, equipped with free Wi-Fi and a wide choice of modern conveniences to guarantee a truly memorable stay. High speed Wi-Fi is available in all areas with unlimited device and is free of charge. At this property guests can enjoy a wide ranging buffet of international cuisine all day, and the coffee shop also offers a selection of juices, coffees, pastries and cookies. Guests can relax in the hot tub, visit the fitness centre to enjoy an invigorating workout or enjoy the rooftop pool, as well as experience various spa treatments and massages. This stunning establishment is ideally located for easy access to Deira and Al Ghurair shopping malls, Dubai Creek gold and yacht club and Gold souq, amongst other nearby attractions. The hotel offers a daily shuttle service to the beach and major shopping malls in Dubai. Free private on-site parking is also available.

selected.name: Armada Hotel Old City Sultanahmet
selected.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, the hotel offers excellent views of the biggest attractions and are just steps away from Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace and Sultanahmet Square. Ataturk airport is to be reached within 20-minute drive. Each of the rooms at this hotel combines traditional Ottoman style with modern amenities. After a long day of sightseeing, enjoy a relaxing bath with natural olive oil soaps and use the traditional cotton towels from Bursa or enjoy a comfortable night's sleep on beds equipped with goose-down pillows and duvets. Guests will start the day with a delicious buffet breakfast, including home-made pastries bakery and admire the stunning views of Istanbul's most beautiful historic buildings, as well as the Marmara Sea and the Bosphorous from the rooftop terrace.

alternatives.name: Arcadia Blue Istanbul Hotel
alternatives.description: This hotel is located in Sultanahmet, in the heart of Istanbul, a city which has always attracted travellers with its history, its nature, and its archaeological significance. Shops, bars and restaurants are located in the immediate vicinity, as are the famous Hagia Sophia and the Hippodrome. It is approximately 500 m to the Grand Bazaar, while Taksim Square is some 5 kms away. Guests will reach the airport in about 15 kms. Restored in 2006, a total of 48 rooms are on offer within this traditional building, which still reflects the architectural style of the 19th century. The interiors and decoration have been hand-crafted. In the hotel restaurant guests may enjoy outstanding Turkish and international cuisine in a traditional atmosphere with live music all day long, next to a terrace with views of historically important monuments.

alternatives.name: Lady Diana
alternatives.address: Binbirdirek Mah Terzihane Sok No 9 Sultanahmet, No:9
alternatives.description: Located in the heart of Istanbul's historic Old City, this newly opened hotel is surrounded by Ottoman-era landmarks. Guests can enjoy on-site dining, shopping, and conference facilities, as well as a Turkish bath, gym, and sauna. All air-conditioned rooms include en suite bathrooms, complimentary internet access, and LCD TVs. The rooftop restaurant offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Old Peninsula, including the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. For airport transfers or sightseeing tours, please contact the concierge at info@ladydianahotel. com.

alternatives.name: Renata Suites Boutique Hotel
alternatives.description: A New breath, a new space, new pleasures, new emotions, your home-comfort and office ergonomy. The Hotel invites you to give a different sight to Istanbul.  Renata Boutique Hotel is in the city centre and only 4 minutes away from Taksim Square via Underground. The hotel is within walking distance to Lütfi Kırdar International Convention and Exhibition Centre and only 3 minutes away from the biggest malls in Istanbul and the region via Underground. The hotel is located very near to Osmanbey Underground Station and the distance to Istanbul Atatürk Airport is 23 km.

activity.name: Bosphorus Sunset Cruise
activity.description: An enchanted evening cruise starts while you sip your welcome drink and enjoy the marvelous scenery as the sun sets on the Bosphorus. Chance to view and photograph the precious relics of three world dominating Empires: Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman. The royal Dolmabahçe Palace, the late residence of the Ottoman Sultans; Bosphorus and Fatih Sultan Mehmet Bridges connecting the two continents Asia and Europe; Rumeli Fortress, the historical armament built by the Conqueror Sultan, marble palaces, ancient wooden villas of Ottoman style besides modern residentials.
